subject: Biology
_transcription: Biology = pages p01-p02 (printed page numbers 3-4) under the 'Biology' heading: Q1-Q9 on p01, Q10-Q15 on p02. The paper numbers its 60 questions straight through (Biology 1-15, Chemistry 16-30, Mathematics 31-45, Physics 46-60); Biology's printed numbers 1-15 already match ref/questionNumber. Numbers checked unbroken 1..15 against the printed 'N.' labels. Options are boxed A-D; on some questions they are laid out in two columns (A, B left; C, D right) and are kept in A-D order. No answer key. Q1's six numbered items are printed as a 3-column grid and are typed as a numbered list. Q15 has a stem figure (three restriction-site diagrams with cut arrows).

rows.text:
Match the following features to the animals. Which is the correct combination?

1. Open circulatory system
2. Closed circulatory system
3. Earthworm
4. Malpighian tubules
5. Nephridia
6. Cockroach
Take two plants, keep plant A in very dry conditions and plant B in high humidity. Simultaneously, immerse the roots of both plants in water with a red dye. What would you observe?
options: Plant A turns redder than Plant B.
Plant B turns redder than Plant A.

rows.text: A population of finch birds with medium sized beaks colonizes an island with plants producing medium and large sized seeds. After a disease wipes out all the plants with medium sized seeds, what is most likely to happen to the finches?
options: Their beaks will not change at all.

rows.text: If the population of a city of 100 people increases at an intrinsic rate of 0.1, but the city only has access to food and housing for 200 people, what will the current growth rate of the population be?
Pick the INCORRECT statement regarding a mitochondrion,
options: The inner and outer membranes have identical sets of enzymes.
The mitochondrial matrix contains single circular DNA molecule.
The inner membrane forms many infoldings called cristae.

rows.text: Which of the following statements best describes the G0 stage of the cell cycle?
options: Cells in this stage are dying.
Cells in this stage are metabolically active but not dividing.
Cells in this stage are highly proliferative.
Cells in this stage are proliferative but metabolically inactive.
Administering anti-Rh antibodies to a Rh +ve woman before her first pregnancy.
Administering anti-Rh antibodies to a Rh +ve mother after her first Rh +ve child birth.
Administering anti-Rh antibodies to a Rh -ve woman before her first pregnancy.
Administering anti-Rh antibodies to a Rh -ve mother after her first Rh +ve child birth.

rows.text: During an oxidative phosphorylation the terminal electron acceptor is ______ (fill up the blank)
Immature lymphocytes are primarily found in which one of the following organs?

If an enzyme reaction follows the Michaelis Menten kinetics represented by the equation:

\(V_0 = V_{max} \cdot \dfrac{[S]}{K_M + [S]}\)

where, \(V_0\) is the initial reaction velocity, \(V_{max}\) is the maximal reaction velocity, \(K_M\) is the Michaelis constant and \([S]\) is the substrate concentration. Which of the following statements is correct?
options: \(K_M\) is the concentration of the enzyme at the optimal pH.
\(K_M\) is the reaction velocity at half the optimal substrate concentration.
\(K_M\) is the concentration of substrate when the velocity of the reaction is half that of the maximal velocity.
\(K_M\) is the concentration of the enzyme at the optimal temperature.

rows.text: Common cold is mostly caused by Rhinoviruses. Which of the following treatments will provide the best cure from this infectious agent?
options: A glass of Oral Rehydration Suspension (ORS) plus two tablets of streptomycin twice a day for three days.
Two tablets of amoxycillin twice a day for at least three days.
One tablet of amoxycillin plus one tablet of a pain killer four times a day for at least three days.
Adequate rest and a balanced diet for at least three days.

rows.text: In human females, when does oogenesis begin?
Which one of the following statements best defines properties of a compound epithelium?
options: It is multilayered and mainly protects from chemical and mechanical stresses.
It is multilayered and covers the outer lining of secretory glandular epithelium.
It is multilayered and help binding tissues together and their eventual organization.
It is multilayered and actively participates in secretion and absorption.

rows.text: Which one of the following pairs of genotype and phenotype ratios will be obtained in F2 generation for Snapdragon plants exhibiting incomplete dominance for red and white flower color traits?

Provided below are recognition sequences for restriction enzymes 1 (RE1), 2 (RE2) and 3 (RE3). Arrows indicate the positions where the enzymes digest on the two strands. Which of the following can the RE1 digested DNA ligate to?
options: All three RE1, RE2 and RE3 digested DNA.
Only to RE1 and RE3 digested DNA.
Only to RE1 and RE2 digested DNA.

figure.note: Three double-stranded DNA segments drawn as boxed base pairs flanked by helices. RE1: top strand A A G C T T, bottom strand T T C G A A. RE2: top C A G C T G, bottom G T C G A C. RE3: top G A G C T C, bottom C T C G A G. In each, a down arrow above the top strand marks a cut between the 1st and 2nd base, and an up arrow below the bottom strand marks a cut between the 5th and 6th base (staggered cuts).
